publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: Original power consumer accepts synthetic battery states
record.method: Original SpringBoard consumer observations against controlled power-source samples
record.observation: Original userspace consumed charging, unplugged discharge and externally powered full-battery states from the power-source service in QEMU.
record.limits: These are synthetic battery samples. They validate consumer wiring, not physical battery capacity, charging current or a sustainable power budget.

records.access: Private project record; only the selected excerpt is distributed

exhibits.title: Original power consumer accepts synthetic battery states
exhibits.interpretation: A changing original consumer distinguishes a working service contract from merely publishing a similarly named object. Physical power is reviewed separately in E31.
